_comment: Framework configuration and the provenance of the delivered rate card (D55). The RATES live in the delivered CSV at SCENARIO_FEES_SOURCE - feeRates.csv beside this file by default - one row per cell; the tiers and fee groups are derived from those rows. This file holds only what is not the delivering team's to say: the schedules, the level vocabulary in its order, the default level, the placeholder flag. Local adjustments are an overlay in the scenario store, never edits to the delivery. A schedule marked `marginal` is priced progressively: the MANDATE SIZE fills the tiers in turn, each band pays its own tier rate, and the blended result is the one rate every product carries (D83). A schedule that is not marginal reads a single tier, chosen by the top account size, as it always has.

schedules.note: Marginal: the mandate fills the tiers in turn and each band pays its own tier rate. One blended rate then prices every product.
Each product priced by its fee group, set by the top account size.

delivery.source: placeholder card generated in-repo, not a delivery
